bootstrap.conditioning: Intervals are conditional on the fixed nested-CV out-of-fold predictions and fitted fold-specific thresholds; bootstrap replicates do not refit probes, scalers, hyperparameters, or thresholds.
bootstrap.procedure: sample games with replacement within each outer fold; recompute each fold metric; average fold metrics; use identical draws for ablations

correction.reason: The frozen vectorised AP bootstrap evaluated precision as 0/0 when a game-cluster resample assigned zero weight to leading probability groups. Those empty groups have zero positive increment and must contribute zero, not NaN, to AP.
correction.scope: Only representation game_cluster_bootstrap.average_precision and ablation paired_game_cluster_bootstrap.average_precision records are recomputed. Fold point estimates and every non-AP field reproduce the original report exactly.

metric_notes.balanced_accuracy: uses each outer fold's inner-CV-selected threshold
metric_notes.f1: uses each outer fold's inner-CV-selected threshold
metric_notes.fold_sd: sample standard deviation across outer folds (ddof=1)
